about: Built by tools/money/pythia_dates.py from rules and from the repo's saved calendar (data/news/events.csv). Never guessed: a date is here only when a rule or a saved official calendar gives it; verify: true means confirm it on the official page (agencies move releases and exchanges change holiday hours). A release whose date is not known is in 'undated' with the name of the official calendar to look it up (text only). All times are New York (ET) clock times.
